module purpose: neorv32_spi is a bus-mapped SPI host: a bus write with address bit 2 = '0' stores a control register (enable, clock phase and polarity, prescaler, divider, high-speed, interrupt enables), a bus write with address bit 2 = '1' pushes a data byte or chip-select command into a TX FIFO sub-unit, and a transceiver state machine pops each word, shifts the byte out on spi_dat_o with a clock on spi_clk_o paced by a divided clkgen_i tick, samples spi_dat_i into the same shift register, writes the received byte into an RX FIFO sub-unit that the bus reads back, drives the chip selects spi_csn_o, exports the enable on clkgen_en_o and raises irq_o from enabled FIFO and idle conditions.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, cpha, cpol, prsc, cdiv, highspeed, four interrupt enables) taken from the bus write data when stb, rw and address bit 2 = '0' hold
a data byte or chip-select command word pushed into the TX FIFO by a qualified bus write, then fetched by the idle transceiver
divided bit-clock tick spi_clk_en produced from the selected clkgen_i bit or the high-speed bit and the divider compare
serial transfer: SCK edges from cpol and cpha, input sampling, bit counting, shifting, and data and clock outputs
chip-select command stored from a TX FIFO command word and decoded onto spi_csn_o
interrupt request from enabled FIFO and idle conditions, and status bits (FIFO flags, chip-select active, busy) for the bus
control settings returned on a read with address bit 2 = '0'; received byte written to the RX FIFO on completion and popped by a read with address bit 2 = '1'
control register, response, interrupt, engine fields, chip selects, divider and tick forced to constants while rstn_i = '0'
disable: with ctrl.enable = '0' both FIFOs are cleared, the engine falls into the others arm (chip select cleared, SCK at idle level), the divider count is cleared and irq_o is forced low
